messages:
maria: Quick sync on RCA-421 action items — we need to lock owners + due dates. There are a couple CRs blocking the rollout. Owners I called out: @ajay (infra rollback + canary), @danielle (client telemetry fix), @simon (CR reviews). Please confirm your final due dates; I want a canary cutover plan by Mon EOD.
ajay: Ack. I'll take infra rollback hooks and smoke tests. Targeting 2025-02-14 for hooks + tests. Need a quick CR from @simon to gate the feature flag.
simon: Got it — I can review today. Which PR should I look at?
ajay: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 — contains rollback hooks and the flag checks.
danielle: I'll own the telemetry fix. ETA Fri 2025-02-09 EOD PST. PR nearly there but blocked on a flaky unit test in `tests/telemetry/test_event_queue.py`. Investigating race.
maria: Thanks. @ajay once hooks are merged can you confirm canary window and the exact health thresholds so I can wire alerts in the console? Need numbers to put in the postmortem.
ajay: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 4h, error-rate threshold 0.5% (5xx), p95 latency < 150ms. I'll create the canary dashboard and baseline alerts, and document steps in the RCA tracker.
simon: Quick review done — left 2 tiny comments on the PR. Once addressed I'll approve. Also flagged one interface change that touches the client SDK to @danielle.
danielle: Saw the comments, will update SDK shape and push changes in ~3h. Local run shows flaky test due to an event loop race; adding a small delay and retry in the test to stabilize.
infra-bot: deploy note: canary-dashboard created by @ajay at 2025-02-10T09:05Z
maria: Perfect — final ask: please update the postmortem action tracker with your due dates and PR links. I'll do a sweep Tue morning and escalate any outstanding blockers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
